name: gutenberg-mcp-server
description: Search, browse, and read 78,000+ public-domain books from Project Gutenberg with full plain-text retrieval and offset/limit chunking via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

GUTENDEX_BASE_URL.title: Gutendex base URL
GUTENDEX_BASE_URL.description: Gutendex catalog API base URL, used for search and popularity browse when the local catalog mirror cannot answer. Leave blank for the public instance.

GUTENBERG_TEXT_BASE_URL.title: Gutenberg content mirror URL
GUTENBERG_TEXT_BASE_URL.description: Project Gutenberg content mirror serving the /cache/epub tree: book text, the bulk catalog archive, and per-book catalog records. Leave blank for gutenberg.pglaf.org.

GUTENBERG_MIRROR_PATH.title: Catalog mirror path
GUTENBERG_MIRROR_PATH.description: Path to the local catalog-mirror SQLite file. Leave blank to use the per-user default that gutenberg-mcp-server mirror init builds.

GUTENBERG_MIRROR_REFRESH_CRON.title: Catalog refresh schedule
GUTENBERG_MIRROR_REFRESH_CRON.description: Cron schedule for an in-process catalog-mirror refresh, e.g. 0 4 * * *; on an empty mirror the first run is the full harvest. Leave blank to disable.
